description: Na₃HoCl₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Cl¹⁻ atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent HoCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-46°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.71-2.84 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven Cl¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.80-3.44 Å. Ho³⁺ is bonded to six Cl¹⁻ atoms to form HoCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-46°. There are a spread of Ho-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.61-2.63 Å. There are three inequivalent Cl¹⁻ sites. In the first Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Ho³⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ClNa₃Ho trigonal pyramids. In the second Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Ho³⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ClNa₃Ho trigonal pyramids. In the third Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na¹⁺ and one Ho³⁺ atom.
